text:
alex_sales: heads up — Silverpine procurement emailed: they will not accept an invoice until we have an official purchase requisition signed by their finance team. they specifically require company legal name, billing address, VAT/Tax ID, and a PO number printed on the invoice. they want this before we generate invoice for the June commitment.

maria_support: thanks alex. do we have the customer's billing contact + the exact legal entity name? any contract SOW reference they want on the PO? :thinking:

kevin_finance: policy: for Net30 on enterprise, accounting needs a PO or signed requisition. we can issue a proforma invoice if they need proof of amount while they process the PO — but final invoice will wait for PO details. 

alex_sales: forwarding what Silverpine sent earlier: "Please send a signed purchase requisition or PO. Billing details below. No invoice will be accepted without our PO." they attached a PO template. i've asked them to confirm the legal name and VAT ID.

maria_support: can we run a quick check if issuing a proforma will allow them to provision tokens/credits? or is provisioning tied to invoice issuance? @payments-bot any flags?

payments-bot: Payment policy note: provisional access can be granted on a case-by-case basis for enterprise evals. Requires approvals from finance + sales. Create ticket: FIN-4567 and include signed requisition.

kevin_finance: if sales gets the signed requisition this week, accounting can backdate invoice to 2024-06-30 and send it immediately. otherwise we'll hold invoice and issue once PO is on file.

sam_engineer: customer mentioned they're trying to spin up dedicated capacity tomorrow. is there a tech block if invoice delayed? we don't want their staging to be interrupted.

maria_support: engineering note: provisioning isn't tied to invoice creation; it's a billing policy. we can keep their dedicated cluster active while finance completes paperwork (needs proforma approval). i've pinged infra to mark as "do not suspend" for that org. :white_check_mark:

alex_sales: copied silverpine contact: procurement@silverpine.com. asked them to return requisition to sales@redwood.com and cc accounting@redwood.com. asked for PO number format if they have one.

maria_support: helpful snippet they asked us to fill for their procurement portal (they requested we paste it):

```
Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Billing address: 1208 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103
VAT/Tax ID: US-EIN 82-1234567
Reference: SOW-2024-07 (if applicable)
```

maria_support: quick plan: 1) sales to obtain signed requisition/PO from Silverpine, 2) finance to prepare proforma if they request immediate proof, 3) accounting to issue final invoice once PO received. I'll track FIN-4567.

kevin_finance: noted. if procurement insists on a vendor onboarding doc, ask them to fill their template and we'll sign. request ETA — procurement timelines vary.

alex_sales: silverpine replied: "we can get the signed requisition by 2024-07-03 EOD. can you provide a proforma in the meantime?"

maria_support: we'll prepare a proforma per finance. i'll attach the template to the ticket and loop in kevin.

kevin_finance: i'll draft proforma and attach standard terms, invoice will remain pending until official PO arrives. ping me if SLA required for provisioning.

maria_support: thanks everyone — closing the Slack thread, tracking under FIN-4567 and sales task SPR-892. will update when signed requisition lands. :thumbsup:
